title: OKC wet spell leads CF 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Oklahoma City precipitation 20d z-score > 1 (wet spell, mirror of the drought rule) leads CF log returns by 5 days (+) as rain restores side-dress nitrogen demand; long CF 5d [weather.oklahoma_city.precip -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0050)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.oklahoma_city.precip rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Oklahoma City precipitation 20d z-score > 1 (wet spell) leads CF absolute returns by 3 days (+) - rain shocks move nitrogen demand uncertainty rather than direction, so volatility not sign should respond; null-control of the failed directional R2-0149 [weather.oklahoma_city.precip -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0149)
